math_steps.explanation:
$$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=\dfrac{a}{x},\ 0 < x \leq 1\\\text{倒数项系数}\ a<0\Rightarrow a\in \left(-\infty, 0\right)\end{gathered}$$

$$\begin{gathered}f\!\left(x\right)=x-\dfrac{a}{x}-2,\ x > 1\\x+\dfrac{k}{x},\ k=- a\\k\le 0\ \text{或}\ \sqrt{k}\le 1\Leftrightarrow k\le 1\\- a\le 1\Rightarrow a\in \left[-1, +\infty\right)\end{gathered}$$
math_steps.title: $0 < x \leq 1$ 这一段

math_steps.explanation: $$\begin{gathered}0 < x \leq 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left(-\infty, 0\right)\\x > 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left[-1, +\infty\right)\\\text{分界点 }x=1:\ a\in \left(-\infty, - \frac{1}{2}\right]\\\text{取交集}:\ a\in \left[-1, - \frac{1}{2}\right]\end{gathered}$$

items.label: 已确认条件
items.math: \begin{gathered}0 < x \leq 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left(-\infty, 0\right)\\x > 1\ \text{段}:\ a\in \left[-1, +\infty\right)\\\text{分界点 }x=1:\ a\in \left(-\infty, - \frac{1}{2}\right]\end{gathered}
